name: The Aeolus Horn
description: Blow it, and the wind blows the way you point it. Sail any heading you choose. The Company will never stop hunting you for it.

name: Lucky doubloon
description: A coin that always lands heads. +20% gold from prizes.

name: Master's sextant
description: You always know a quieter route. The Company hunt grows 1 slower each day.

name: Brass gun sights
description: Taken from a Navy gunnery school. +5% accuracy.

name: Powder monkeys
description: Quick lads who keep the guns fed. Reload 10% faster.

name: Ship's cat
description: Good luck, and death to rats. +1 morale every day at sea.

name: Surgeon's chest
description: Laudanum, lint and a clean saw. Specialists recover 15 more health after a win.

name: Carpenter's stores
description: Seasoned oak and a keg of nails. +3 hull patched after every win.

name: Spare canvas
description: A sail locker that's never empty. +5 sails mended after every win.

name: Smuggler's ledger
description: Names, prices and who owes whom. Everything in port costs 10% less.

name: Letters of introduction
description: Forged, mostly. Reputation gains are half as big again.

name: The grog tub
description: 'The King, God bless him.' Morale losses are a quarter smaller.

name: Boarding axes
description: One for every hand. Your boarders and defenders fight 15% harder.

name: Oak bulkheads
description: Doubled timbers below the waterline. +8 hull.

name: Extra hammocks
description: Slung in every corner. Room for 15 more hands.
